name: whatsapp-unofficial
description: Unofficial, community-built WhatsApp integration: read your own WhatsApp chats from your AI assistant via a local linked device. Read-only by default; sending is opt-in. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.

interface.longDescription:
An unofficial, community-built, open-source integration that lets Codex read your own WhatsApp chats. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.

The plugin links a local program to your account as a WhatsApp linked device (like WhatsApp Web) and keeps everything on your computer: no servers, no telemetry. Codex can list chats, search contacts, read messages with surrounding context and download media.

Safety: read-only by default; sending must be enabled explicitly. Incoming message text is quoted and treated as untrusted data. Data files are owner-only and the control channel is a local socket. Files can only be sent from a dedicated outbox folder.

Risk: unofficial clients may violate WhatsApp's Terms of Service and WhatsApp may restrict or ban your account. Use at your own risk.
defaultPrompt: Link my WhatsApp account so you can read my chats
Summarize my unread WhatsApp messages from today
What did Alex and I last talk about on WhatsApp?
